project: Wuxia Life Early Childhood Origin Infant Quest Chains (Stage-3)
description: Stage-3: replace age 0–2 weighted-random infant passive filler with four ordered origin quest chains (5 nodes each). Ordered dequeue by origin flag, neutral shared filler after chain complete, legacy swaddle merge, and <50% pairwise narrative ID overlap (targets Stage-2 书香×边疆 70.6% overlap). Product truth: docs/PRD/early-childhood-origin-infant-quest-chains.md; quest specs under docs/designs/childhood-*-origin-0-2-quest-spec.md.

userStories.title: Quest chain config schema and loader
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a typed config for four ordered infant quest chains so that content can be tuned without hardcoding in session logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or extend config under src/data/ (e.g. lines/origin-infant-passives.json) with four chains: questId, originFlag, completeFlag, nodes[] (id, order, ageMin, ageMax, title, text, flags, statDeltas, optional legacyCatalogId)
Each chain has exactly 5 nodes with IDs matching quest spec prefixes: scholar_infant_* / martial_infant_* / merchant_infant_* / frontier_infant_*
Export typed loader from src/data/originInfantPassiveChain.ts (OriginInfantPassiveChain, OriginInfantPassiveNode, getOriginInfantPassiveChains)
Schema one-liner documented in originInfantPassiveChain.ts or docs/designs/childhood-origin-infant-passive-index.md
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-001; §3 frozen node ID prefixes; FR-1 one origin chain per playthrough; design index §1 quest IDs and origin flags

userStories.title: Ordered dequeue passive selector for age ≤2
userStories.description: As a player, I want my origin infant story to unfold in fixed order so that early life feels authored and chain nodes never replay.
acceptanceCriteria: selectPassiveNarrative for age ≤2 dequeues next incomplete chain node by origin flag (not weighted random across origins)
Node trigger respects ageMin/ageMax; skip only if prior node flag already set (FR-2)
When chain completeFlag set, fall back to neutral sharedFillers (e.g. infant_crawl_home) — never other origins' chain nodes
eventHistory records chain node ids; completed nodes never replay
HeadlessEngineSessionImpl passive_continue and useNewGameEngine use same selector path
Chain nodes produce periodSummary with spec title/body/deltas (FR-3)
Deprecate or gate legacy infant_swaddle_* catalog entries so N2 legacyCatalogId merge does not double-trigger (FR-4)
Disturbance pool remains disabled for age ≤7 (FR-5, inherit Stage-1)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-002; §3 frozen decisions (no planning, Δ≤1); touchpoints infantPassiveNarratives.ts, originInfantPassiveChain.ts, HeadlessEngineSessionImpl.executePassiveChildhoodTick; design index §5 swaddle merge map

userStories.title: Origin divergence regression to age 2
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want automated proof that four origins diverge before age 3, closing the Stage-2 书香×边疆 overlap gap.
acceptanceCriteria: Test or headless script runs four origins (书香门第/武林世家/商贾之家/边疆异族) each to age 2 and exports narrative event ids
All C(4,2)=6 origin pairs have narrative id overlap <50% (especially 书香×边疆 must drop below 50% from Stage-2 70.6%)
Ages 0–2: planningOptions.length === 0 throughout; no chivalry/internalSkill absurd jumps
npm run gate:p16 passes
Save sample output under docs/test-reports/early-childhood-origin-chains-stage3.md with reproducible commands
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
